infra.editor.name: Profile name
infra.editor.nameInvalid: Only letters, digits, and . _ @ : / + = - are allowed.
infra.editor.nameCollides: A profile with this name already exists — saving will overwrite it.
infra.editor.keepHint: Leave a field blank to keep its current value unchanged.
infra.editor.regionUnset: Not set (AWS CLI will report a missing Region)
infra.editor.region.detected.app: Auto-detected from the region pinned for the app.
infra.editor.overwriteConfirm.title: Overwrite existing profile?
infra.editor.overwriteConfirm.descriptio: A profile named "{name}" already exists — saving will overwrite it in ~/.aws.
infra.editor.error.EXISTS: A profile with this name already exists.
infra.editor.error.NOT_FOUND: That profile no longer exists — the list may be out of date.
infra.editor.error.PROCESS_READONLY: This profile uses credential_process — it's read-only and can't be written from here.
infra.editor.error.UNKNOWN_KEY: One of the config keys isn't supported.
infra.editor.error.WRITE_FAILED: Couldn't write the file — try again.
infra.editor.error.VERIFY_FAILED: Write succeeded but re-verifying it failed — the previous version was restored automatically.
infra.editor.identity.title: Identity check
infra.editor.static.title: Static keys
infra.editor.static.hint: Written straight to ~/.aws/credentials in a single save — AWOG doesn't keep a copy.
infra.editor.static.loaded: Loaded the current keys from ~/.aws/credentials — edit them directly, or clear a field to keep what is already on disk.
infra.editor.static.accessKeyIdPhKeep: Leave blank to keep the current key
infra.editor.static.accessKeyFormatWarn: Doesn't look like a standard AWS access key id (AKIA/ASIA + 16 chars) — AWS does use other formats, so this is just a heads-up.
infra.editor.static.secretPhKeep: Leave blank to keep the current secret
infra.editor.static.sessionTokenPhKeep: Leave blank to keep the current token
infra.editor.sso.ssoSessionHint: References a [sso-session] block already in ~/.aws/config (create one via Import from SSO).
infra.editor.assumeRole.externalIdPh: Given to you by the account owner
infra.editor.process.title: credential_process — read-only
infra.editor.process.body: This profile's credentials come from a command that runs on every AWS CLI call. AWOG doesn't write this in v1 — edit ~/.aws/config directly to change it.
infra.editor.login.title: Console sign-in profile
infra.editor.error.LOGIN_READONLY: A Console sign-in profile can only change its name and Region — the session is created by the sign-in command and AWOG cannot write it. To change the kind, delete the profile and create it again.
infra.editor.login.sameSession: The same sign-in session is also used by profile: {names}. If you only need one profile for that account, delete one of them.
infra.editor.login.body: This profile signs in with your Console session — there are no long-lived keys in ~/.aws. The session and its tokens live in the AWS CLI cache; AWOG never reads them. You can change the NAME and REGION here; use Sign in again only when an AWS command reports an expired session.
infra.editor.region.requiredHint: No Region chosen. Without one, every AWS command of this profile fails with "You must specify a region".
infra.editor.region.requiredFooter: No Region chosen, so saving is off.
